text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After winning race after race with Gold Ship,
I was basking in the afterglow for a moment when—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"DAMMIIIIIIIIIII
IIIIIIIIIIITTTTT!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I couldn't master it... No matter what I tried,
I just couldn't do it—the shadow clone technique!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If I recall correctly, when she won the hot spring trip ticket
at the shopping district raffle, she mentioned something
about mastering cloning herself.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, the raffle thing! I was thinking I'd clone myself
so I could enjoy it twice as much, but—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"In the end, I couldn't learn it!
My hot springs voucher is gonna expire at this rate...!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
So we're going on a trip before it expires!
You're coming with me!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And so, out of nowhere, I was suddenly going on a hot spring trip with Gold Ship. And then—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We boarded the train to the inn and set off for our destination.
...Everything was going well until then, that is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, Gold Ship—who was supposed
to be sitting nearby—had somehow vanished.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Getting no reply after sending a text,
I decided to get off at the next station and make a call.
And then—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "Yo, Trainer. Was waitin' for your call."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: "Head out of that station, 500 steps south, then 700 steps east. I'll be waitin' there. Later!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The call cut off there,
and no matter how many times I redialed, it wouldn't connect...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Upon arriving at the designated location,
the phone suddenly began to ring――

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"Yo. Next up: 700 paces north, 1,200 paces west.
I'll be waitin' there. Later!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Once again, the call abruptly ended...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And walking just as I was told—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Welcome, traveler.
It must have been a difficult journey to get here.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
There are many monsters around here, so it is dangerous.
Please rest at this inn for the night.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Come, quickly. Before the monster eats you.
Hurry.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I had no idea what was going on—but
I couldn't just leave Gold Ship behind,
so I decided to head inside the inn.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for waiting,
here is your food~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She's stayed like this even after going inside.
—I feel like I've got no choice but to just roll with it."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Tempura made with wild mountain vegetables picked nearby,
wild vegetable miso soup, and wild vegetable nibitashi.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We have wild mountain green sashimi, seared wild greens,
simmered wild greens, and live-served wild greens.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Please feel free to enjoy the bath after your meal~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...After finishing our meal of wild mountain greens,
we arrived at the entrance of the hot spring.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For now, we decided to take a dip in the hot springs—but...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (GYOEEEEEEEEEEEHHH!!!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Suddenly, an animal cry like nothing I'd ever heard
echoed through the air...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While I was still surprised, next—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BOOM!!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"A loud, violent crash echoed through the air!
Terrified, I scrambled right out of the hot spring!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Customer, that was a close call.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"However, please rest assured.
The screeching bird is gone now."

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
You'll be safe inside the inn.
Please relax and make yourself at home.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I shall also take my time and relax as I please.
Until later, then~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In the bath...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Getting back to the room was fine and all,
but I have no idea what the situation actually is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Exhausted from not understanding a single thing,
sleep eventually took over...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It felt like a moment where
an irreplaceable bond formed between
Gold Ship and me... maybe?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the next time I opened my eyes—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Trainer!
Crack those joints and stay lively today!
choice_data_list: She's already back at the academy...!?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huh? The hell are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
I was here from the start, wasn't I?
Stop saying weird stuff.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...What could this mean?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Could that incident
have been... a dream?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: However, a few days later, while checking my email—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I received an email from an unknown address that said,
'Thank you for staying at our inn' ...
